facts.fact: The Thurai landed two dawns before chapter 1 under the cloud, unseen from the hill; Pazhayangadi burned the day before.
Muthu's crown order is a standing order for a fleet landing, sent before the rains.
The plank holds forty-two names once Neela chalks hers last; the Company still calls itself 'the forty'.
Thilak offers one pinch each, split even, to last the week.
